name: cavemio-changelog-timeline
title: Changelog timeline
description: What shipped, drawn as you read: a rail that fills, dots that light, filters that fold the rest away.

cavemio.accessibility:
- An ordered list of articles with real <time> elements; each title links to its own anchor.
- The filter is a radio group (arrow keys move); the count of updates is announced politely when it changes.
- Folded releases are inert and hidden from assistive tech.
- The scroll listener is passive, throttled to one update a frame and only active while the timeline is on screen.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion, releases are simply there and nothing slides.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: entries
props.description: – · Newest first: id (its anchor), date, title, and any of version, tags, body, media.

props.name: filters
props.description: – · The switch’s options; by default the tags found in the entries (new, improved and fixed get their own labels and tints).

features.title: A rail that fills as you read
features.description: The line fills as you scroll and each release’s dot lights when the line reaches it.

features.title: Filter by kind
features.description: All, New, Improved and Fixed. Releases that don’t match fold away and the count rolls.

features.title: Older releases wait
features.description: After the first few, “Show 6 older” folds the rest open, and the label becomes “Show fewer”.

features.title: Every release has a link
features.description: Each has an anchor, and its title links to it, so you can point people at one update.

features.title: Entries arrive as you read
features.description: Each release rises out of a light blur the first time it comes into view.

features.title: Real markup
features.description: An ordered list of articles with <time> elements. Folded releases are hidden from assistive tech.

states.title: read
states.description: The line fills the rail to 55% of the way down the screen as you scroll; a dot’s centre fills (420ms, slight overshoot) and its ring darkens as the line passes it. It only listens while the timeline is on screen.

states.title: arrive
states.description: Each release rises 14px out of a 4px blur (700ms) the first time it scrolls into view.

states.title: filter
states.description: The pill is thrown to the chosen tag (460ms); releases without it fold to nothing (480ms) and the count rolls.

states.title: older
states.description: Beyond initialCount, releases fold open on "Show 6 older", whose label morphs to "Show fewer".
